/bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- home ---\\n' && sed -n '1,280p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- grid ---\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' app/ProductGrid.tsx"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- detail ---' && sed -n '1,320p' 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && printf '\\n--- skeleton ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && printf '\\n--- css ---\\n' && sed -n '1,360p' app/globals.css && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files"
/bin/bash -c 'find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
/bin/bash -c "cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- product data ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' lib/products.ts && printf '\\n--- installed versions ---\\n' && npm ls next react react-dom --depth=0"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n 'ViewTransition|viewTransition|startViewTransition' node_modules/next node_modules/react node_modules/react-dom --glob '*.{d.ts,js,json,md}' | head -100; printf '\\n--- repo instructions ---\\n'; for f in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md /workspace/app/AGENTS.md /workspace/app/product/AGENTS.md /workspace/app/product/'[slug]'/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f \""'$f" ]; then printf '"'\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done'

/bin/bash -c "node -e \"for (const name of ['ViewTransition','addTransitionType','startTransition']) console.log(name, typeof require('react')[name]); console.log('react', require('react/package.json').version, 'react-dom', require('react-dom/package.json').version)\" && npm view react@19.3.0 version && npm view @types/react version"
